append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 2, dark): the persistent cart store. Migration 20270346039000_commerce_carts.sql adds public.commerce_carts (one row per buyer, profile_id primary key, lines jsonb array capped at 50, service role only, RLS on with no policy) with a pgTAP guard in supabase/tests/commerce_carts.test.sql. lib/commerce/cart-store.ts loads (through parseCart), saves, adds, sets, removes and merges a guest cart; app/(main)/marketplace/cart-actions.ts exposes them behind COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED (blank = dark, gate in RUNBOOKS 'Persistent cart'); an Add to cart button sits beside Buy now on /market/<id> only when the switch is on. Still open: checkout from a saved cart, a /cart page, prune-on-read against live stock, P3 shipping profiles and P4 facets (Packet G UI). Daniel applies the SQL in Frequency Community after merge. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P3/P4 fixture UI, Packet G, dark): components/marketplace/etsy-preview.tsx is a read-only shipping-options display plus labelled kit controls for category, tag, condition, price, seller type and sort, owned by a fixture caller and covered by etsy-preview.test.tsx. No live listing query, shipping quote, cart wiring or checkout is attached; the public product page still reads nothing from it. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 3, dark): the /cart page (app/(main)/cart/page.tsx, standard Index shell and rail). It lists the saved lines with the live product or variant price, says what is no longer for sale or was lowered to stock (lib/commerce/cart-view.ts, display only, nothing written back), and lets the buyer change quantity or remove a line. It answers 404 until COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED is set. Still open: checkout from the saved cart, live shipping quotes, and writing pruned lines back. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 4, dark): checkout from the saved cart behind COMMERCE_CART_CHECKOUT_ENABLED (needs the cart switch). startCartCheckoutAction (app/(main)/marketplace/cart-actions.ts) loads the stored cart through lib/commerce/cart-load.ts (the same door /cart reads), prices and prunes it from the live rows, and pays it through createCommerceCheckout unchanged, so the existing one-seller and multi-seller funds flows apply. components/marketplace/cart-checkout.tsx is the Check out control on /cart (on-page card form, hosted fallback); the cart is emptied after the on-page payment settles. Still open: a Stripe test-mode run of a two-seller cart, emptying the cart on the hosted return, live shipping quotes.
